entities.summary: Kaza Kajami-Keane is a Canadian-Jamaican professional basketball player for Löwen Braunschweig of the Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). He played college basketball for the Illinois State Redbirds, the Cleveland State Vikings and the Carleton Ravens. He has also competed for the Canadian national basketball team.
